title: Super Strong Approximation for Markoff modulo-p graphs
statement:
For each prime $p$, let $\mathcal{G}_p$ be the corresponding Markoff modulo-$p$ graph. **Super Strong Approximation.** The collection of Markoff modulo-$p$ graphs $(\mathcal{G}_p)_p$ forms an expander family.

This is the spectral-expansion formulation of super-strong approximation for the Markoff graphs and is used in the paper to obtain uniform bounds for lifts along shortest paths. It is explicitly described as expected, with the source pointing to experimental evidence; the conjecture remains open.
source_name: Elisa Bellah, Siran Chen, Elena Fuchs and Lynnelle Ye, “Bounding Lifts of Markoff Triples mod p”, arXiv:2311.11468 (2023).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.11468

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of November 2023).
